description: Na₆W₁₀O₃₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.76 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.93 Å. There are five inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.25 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.31 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.35 Å. In the fourth W site, W is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.16 Å. In the fifth W site, W is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.34 Å. There are seventeen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three W atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaW₃ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na and three W atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaW₃ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two W atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three W atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three W atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one W atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent W atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three W atoms. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom.
